# Vendored libraries

`tools/srt_dashboard.py` inlines these two files into the dashboard so it opens offline. They are unchanged
copies of the published builds.

| File | Library | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `chart.umd-4.5.1.min.js` | Chart.js 4.5.1, https://www.chartjs.org | MIT, (c) 2025 Chart.js Contributors |
| `chartjs-adapter-date-fns-3.0.0.bundle.min.js` | chartjs-adapter-date-fns 3.0.0 (bundles date-fns) | MIT, (c) 2022 chartjs-adapter-date-fns Contributors; date-fns MIT, (c) Sasha Koss and Lesha Koss |
